gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-rokkitt: Bold and loose-limbed, Balsamiq Sans draws its lines like one fixed pen, while Rokkitt follows with a bookish text serif. Its quality is a sturdy, friendly warmth.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-sanchez: Chunky, hand-cut charm. Balsamiq Sans pulls its strokes smooth with no pinched curves, and Sanchez counters with a dignified classic serif calm.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-solway: Solway takes the lead with a bookish, authoritative serif voice. Under Balsamiq Sans, its stencil-flat weight and generous openings give the pair a sturdy, confident, expressive character.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-yuji-boku: Balsamiq Sans holds its stencil-cut weight steady through every curve, never pinching, and Yuji Boku sits beneath it as a text serif. Its wide-open c keeps paragraphs inviting.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-nunito-sans: Nunito Sans takes the body, soft and open-mouthed in its small letters. Nunito Sans gives the pencil-line consistency of Balsamiq Sans somewhere gentle to rest below.
gen-gf-baumans-dm-sans: DM Sans is the friendly voice here, with wide-set terminals on its s, set against the wire-like Baumans heading. Baumans commands a headline; DM Sans simply talks.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-paquito: Baumans has a crescent-wrench c and smooth, tube-like lines. Big and short is where it earns its keep, while Paquito, a confident serif with little gap between lowercase and caps, handles the rest.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-aleo: Tubular and distinctive, Baumans cuts its strokes like a fixed-width router bit. And Aleo, a dignified serif with counters the eye slips through, keeps a longer page moving easily.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-almendra-sc: Neon-tube lettering with a wrench-wide c: that is Baumans. Almendra SC then steps in as the classic serif, authoritative and dignified, with mouths that stay open on c, e and a.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-antic-slab: Wire-bright and unmistakable, Baumans stays commanding at one stroke thickness throughout. And Antic Slab, a text serif with round bowls and wide s curves, does the quieter, steadier work.
